qualification: Native ezdxf builders plus public context/model edits; no wire patching; no native AutoCAD rendering claim.
producer_limitations: Native ezdxf1.4.4 omits MULTILEADER CLASS and leaves MLEADERSTYLE instance_count zero; output verification requires correct declarations/counts.
